caption: The video captures a forested creek where pale, smooth bedrock channels a small cascade in the mid-left beside a calm greenish pool in the foreground. Bright daylight glows through the dense canopy at the top center, lighting the leaves, branches, and wet stone surfaces. The cascade keeps tumbling over dark rocks, with white froth continuously rearranging as the water descends into the pool. In the foreground, the pool surface shivers with small ripples and shifting light glints, while the deeper water remains dark. Green shrubs and trees line both banks, and their positions appear steady. The flowing water is the visible change, while the rocky channel, scattered brown leaves, and surrounding foliage stay in place. A quiet, continuous motion of stream water persists, with the composition remaining consistent.
relations: Water flowing over the dark rocks continuously tumbles the cascade, rearranging the white froth as it descends.
The descending water entering the foreground pool causes small ripples and shifting light glints on its surface.
The pale bedrock channel, scattered leaves, and surrounding foliage remain steady while the stream water flows continuously.
